authority: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities Planning Data service
verified_rules: entity search supports json html and geojson extensions
coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the point for selected datasets
UPRN can be supplied through q and is described as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties
geometry_entity can bind a query to an existing entity geometry and geometry_relation controls the spatial predicate
offset and limit paginate results and response links include next prev first and last URLs
bulk dataset pages provide CSV JSON and where applicable GeoJSON and Parquet snapshots
the API has no batch endpoint for portfolios and official guidance recommends bulk downloads for large sets
absence of API results does not prove absence of constraints because geographic coverage varies
WKT geometry queries use WGS84 EPSG:4326
the service is beta and production consumers must allow for API change
